source_binding: These 12 code/test files were frozen before build, all 10 CTests and the diagnostic profile. Documentation and this evidence report were added only after execution. A subsequent publication commit can be verified against these hashes.

worker_scheduling.interpretation: JUCE Linux getPriority returns requested priority storage; start/entry and requested low are confirmed, but effective lowered worker priority is not established. Actual caller pthread_getschedparam succeeds with policy 0 (SCHED_OTHER) and priority 0. No claim of Linux priority benefit.

callback_allocations.scope: Thread-local C++ new/delete operators only; not universal malloc or lock tracing.

independent_audit.review: Independent read-only source review found no blocker and verified original reference function bodies and unchanged gate/load. Native compilation remains pending.

limitations: This batch has no paired frozen 66-condition baseline: performance regression/improvement counts cannot be derived from this evidence alone.
All 66 strict p99 gates pass; 34 deadline misses remain and no claim of stall elimination follows.
Thread CPU spans include test clock/prologue overhead outside the original wall interval; slight CPU > wall does not prove impossible execution or exact DSP-only cost.
Linux cycles are unavailable and are not treated as zero work.
New original-math bit comparisons passed on local GCC; native Windows/MSVC and macOS/AppleClang remain pending.

source_verification.only_prototype_difference: One production comment replaces Scratch-only prototype wording.

scratch_equivalence.cancellation_thresholds: 1, 2, total/2, total-1, total, total+1 for 3 engines at 3 rates; same status/message/checkpoint count/no partial return
scratch_equivalence.invalid_rates: Rates0,7999,384001,+inf,-inf,NaN on each engine: same invalid_argument message, callback never called

quadrature.cache_storage: Function-local static const array shared by v1 and v2/v3 cone functions. The source retains original std::sqrt/std::cos/std::sin expressions; GCC 13.3 -O3 folds this initializer to read-only data (no guard symbol), so dynamic initialization is not claimed for the measured binary.

native_reference_tests.status: Local coherent CTest batch PASS; native MSVC/AppleClang pending.
native_reference_tests.comparison: Exact IEEE double bits of each real and imaginary component.
native_reference_tests.v1_matrix: 2 speakers x 4 sources x 2 pickup anchors x 3 positions x 3 distances x 6 frequencies
native_reference_tests.v2_v3_matrix: 3 drivers x 4 mic variants (none/dynamic/ribbon/condenser) x 2 sources x 2 pickup anchors x 3 positions x 3 distances x 6 frequencies

limits: Single unpinned Linux x86_64 GCC13.3 process after other task builds/probes were reported idle.
One representative worker generator workload; not a full CAB callback p99 or product performance claim.
Six samples per implementation are descriptive, not a tail-latency estimate; the cached129ms and baseline165ms samples are retained.
Windows MSVC and macOS AppleClang byte equivalence are not established by this local probe.
Static-table cold initialization is not included in warmed benchmark; early cancellation still precedes geometry evaluation.

diagnostic_profile.scope: One run per version on local Linux, old preserved binary before rebuild and follow-up after CTest; instrumented diagnostic only. Not a paired 66-condition acceptance baseline or repeatability study. No task affinity/priority/power-plan or sleep changes. All regressions and misses retained.

evidence_note: This repository report retains all route/phase summaries, individual miss pairs and source/binary/log/CSV hashes. Full local raw CSVs/logs remain in the original evidence workspace; native CI publishes its own raw artifacts separately. Local results do not establish Windows/macOS or product release acceptance.
